map.输入皮带型号、中心距、小带轮转速与功率，计算张紧力与挠度值: Enter belt type, center distance, small pulley speed and power to compute tension force and deflection value
map.张紧力依据传递功率、带速与包角；F = 2·P/(v·(1−1/e^μθ)): Tension force is based on transmitted power, belt speed and wrap angle; F = 2 times P / (v times (1 minus 1 / e to the mu theta))
map.依据皮带型号、中心距、小带轮转速、传动功率与小带轮节径，计算所需张紧力并为试车与: Based on belt type, center distance, small pulley speed, transmitted power and small pulley pitch diameter, compute the required tension force and provide data basis for commissioning and tension adjustment.
map.💡 带速 v=π×D1×n/(60×1000)；张紧力 F=K×P×1000/(: Belt speed v = pi times D1 times n / (60 times 1000); tension force F = K times P times 1000 / (v times z); deflection = span / 64
map.挠度测量：在跨距中点施加力，位移应为跨距的 1/64（约16mm/m）: Deflection measurement: apply force at the span midpoint, the displacement should be 1 / 64 of the span (about 16 mm / m)

map.算法：带速 v = π×小带轮直径×转速/60000（m/s）；皮带根数 = ⌈: Algorithm: belt speed v = pi times small pulley diameter times speed / 60000 (m/s); belt count = ceil(transmitted power / single belt rated power) (A 1, B 2, C 4, D 8, SPZ 1.5, SPA 2.5, SPB 4.5 kW); single belt tension = 1.5 times power times 1000 / (belt speed times count) (N); total tension = single times count; midpoint deflection = center distance / 64 (mm); deflection test force = single tension times 0.6; new belt tension = total tension times 1.5. Belt speed greater than 30 too high, greater than 25 high, less than 5 low; pulley diameter smaller than the model minimum prompts.
map.例：B 型带、中心距 500mm、1450rpm、5.5kW、小带轮 125mm: Example: B belt, center distance 500 mm, 1450 rpm, 5.5 kW, small pulley 125 mm gives belt speed 9.49 m/s, count 3, single tension 289.8 N, total tension 869.3 N, midpoint deflection 7.8 mm, test force 173.9 N, new belt tension 1304 N, judged as normal belt speed / suitable pulley diameter. A belt, center distance 800 mm, 2900 rpm, 11 kW, small pulley 90 mm gives belt speed 13.67 m/s, count 11, single 109.8 N, total tension 1207.4 N, deflection 12.5 mm, new belt 1811.1 N.

In practice you should look up the wrap angle coefficient K alpha by the small pulley wrap angle, and overlay the service factor KA (determined by load nature and daily operating time).
map.中点挠度怎么用来调张力？: How to use the midpoint deflection to adjust tension?
map.在两带轮跨距中点垂直施加\"挠度测试力\"，使皮带下压量等于 中心距/64（本例: Apply the deflection test force vertically at the midpoint of the span between the two pulleys; when the belt depression equals center distance / 64 (7.8 mm in this example), the tension is appropriate. New belts have initial elongation, install at 1.5 times the total tension, and re-tighten once after running 24 to 48 hours.
